summary: Deepa Krishnan called expressing severe frustration over a delayed mixer grinder order after two previous calls. Agent Aman Gupta verified her details, raised a logistics ticket, offered a Rs 100 goodwill credit, and arranged a scheduled supervisor callback after a hold attempt. The customer agreed to the callback and the call ended with a full recap.
customer_issue: Delayed mixer grinder delivery after two previous unresolved calls

cap_reasons: Critical step HLD-02 (Adhere to Maximum 2-Minute Hold Ceiling) was missed

policy_results.policy_title: Privacy and Identity Verification Policy: Mandatory Call Recording Disclosure
policy_results.quote: Please note that this call is recorded for quality assurance and training purposes.
policy_results.claim: Agent stated that the call is being recorded for quality assurance and training purposes.
policy_results.explanation: Agent properly delivered the mandatory call recording disclosure in the initial turn as required by PRV-1.2.
policy_results.policy_text: 1. Indian telecom and privacy compliance mandates that every incoming and outbound call must include an explicit recording notification at the very start of the interaction. 2. Representatives must recite the approved disclosure statement during their initial call greeting: - *"Please note this call is recorded for quality assurance and training purposes."* 3. Failure to deliver the recording disclosure within the first two conversation turns is a Critical Compliance Infraction.

policy_results.quote: Our standard delivery commitment is 3 to 7 business days
policy_results.claim: Agent stated standard delivery commitment is 3 to 7 business days.
policy_results.explanation: SHP-1.1 specifies standard delivery transit time as 3 to 7 business days from dispatch.
policy_results.policy_text: 1. ShopEase provides two official shipping tiers across serviced Indian postal codes: - Standard Delivery: Delivery within 3 to 7 business days from order dispatch date. - Express Delivery: Expedited delivery within 1 to 2 business days for eligible metro and tier-1 city pin codes. 2. Orders placed on Sundays and national holidays are packed and handed over to logistics partners on the following working business day.

policy_results.policy_title: Escalation Policy: Priority Support Level SLA Commitments
policy_results.quote: The ticket number is LOG-88213 and the courier partner must respond within 48 hours.
policy_results.claim: Agent stated logistics ticket requires a courier response within 48 hours.
policy_results.explanation: ESC-3.1 mandates that logistics escalation tracking tickets receive courier partner resolution within 48 hours.
policy_results.policy_text: 1. When an escalated case cannot be resolved during the live interaction: - Level-1 Supervisor callbacks must occur within 4 operational hours. - Level-2 Grievance Officer resolutions must be finalized within 24 business hours. - Logistics escalation tracking tickets must receive courier partner resolution within 48 hours.

policy_results.policy_title: Escalation Policy: Warm Transfer Protocol and Hold Regulations
policy_results.quote: I can schedule a confirmed supervisor callback for you within the next 2 to 4 hours.
policy_results.claim: Agent offered a supervisor callback within 2 to 4 hours when no supervisor was available.
policy_results.explanation: ESC-2.1 mandates offering a confirmed supervisor callback SLA within 2 to 4 business hours if no supervisor is available within 2 minutes.
policy_results.policy_text: 1. Before initiating an escalation transfer to a supervisor, the agent must inform the customer and place them on a courtesy hold. 2. Under no circumstance may an agent keep a customer on hold for more than 2 minutes without performing an active check-in (`[HLD-03]`). 3. If no supervisor is immediately available within 2 minutes: - The agent must retrieve the call from hold. - Apologize for the extended wait. - Offer a confirmed Supervisor Callback SLA within 2 to 4 business hours.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling ShopEase. My name is Aman Gupta. Please note that this call is recorded for quality assurance and training purposes. How may I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: This is unacceptable! My name is Deepa Krishnan and I ordered a mixer grinder fifteen days ago. It was dispatched fourteen days ago and nobody gives me a straight answer. This is the third time I am calling and I am fed up.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I am truly sorry, Ms. Krishnan. I can hear how frustrating this has been, especially after calling three times, and I will personally take ownership of this until it is resolved. May I please have your Order ID and the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The order ID is ORD-77302 and the last four digits are 5521. Please just tell me where my parcel is.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, you are verified. Let me make sure I have this right: your mixer grinder was dispatched fourteen days ago with standard delivery, it has not been delivered, and you have already called us twice before. Is that correct?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes! And each time they just say it is in transit.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Could I ask one quick question so I can pinpoint the problem: did you receive any out-for-delivery message or call from the courier in the last few days?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, nothing. Not a single message.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, that helps. Our standard delivery commitment is 3 to 7 business days, so your parcel is well beyond that commitment. Here is what I am doing right now: I am raising a logistics tracking ticket with the courier partner, and I am adding a goodwill wallet credit of Rs 100 to your account for this delay.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: A hundred rupees? I want to speak to a supervisor right now, I want a proper answer from someone senior.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand, Ms. Krishnan. Let me first complete the logistics ticket for you, and then I will make sure someone senior hears you. The ticket number is LOG-88213 and the courier partner must respond within 48 hours.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Forty-eight more hours? I want a supervisor on this call now. This is the second time I am asking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You are absolutely right to ask, and I am escalating this to a supervisor right now. May I place you on a brief hold for up to two minutes while I connect with them?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, go ahead.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for holding, Ms. Krishnan, and I apologise for the wait. Our supervisors are all assisting other escalated callers at the moment. Rather than keep you waiting, I can schedule a confirmed supervisor callback for you within the next 2 to 4 hours. Would that be acceptable?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fine. Please make sure someone actually calls. I have wasted enough time.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I will personally note this as a priority callback, Ms. Krishnan. The supervisor will call you on your registered number ending 5521 within 2 to 4 hours, and the logistics ticket LOG-88213 is already active with the courier. The Rs 100 wallet credit will be added to your account today.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay. That is something at least. Thank you for not just brushing me off.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your patience. To recap: ticket LOG-88213 is raised with the courier with a 48 hour response, a Rs 100 goodwill credit is added, and a supervisor will call you within 2 to 4 hours. Is there anything else I can help you with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that is everything.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for contacting ShopEase, Ms. Krishnan. Have a good day, and again, I am sorry for the trouble.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Bye.
